He drove through highway toll gates over two thousand times without paying. The court gave him life in prison.
Henan, two thousand eight. Farmer Shi Jianfeng runs two trucks hauling sand and gravel.
Tolls eat his profits. Then he notices: army trucks drive through for free.
So he gets fake military licence plates.
For eight months, his trucks roll through the gates. Two thousand, three hundred and sixty-one times.
Then he's caught. Unpaid tolls: three point six eight million yuan.
The court sentences him to life in prison, plus a two million yuan fine. He doesn't appeal.
People across China are furious. Life in prison, for highway tolls?
Then his younger brother walks into a police station.
The trucks were his. The business was his. His big brother had taken the blame.
At a retrial, the tolls are recounted: about four hundred and ninety thousand yuan.
The farmer gets two and a half years. The brother gets seven.
Would you take the fall for your brother?
